verdict.rationale: Postman's Collection format is a documented, ostensibly open JSON spec (postman-docs-16/28) and the Postman API allows programmatic access to assets (postman-docs-5), which could support data export. However, hands-on community reports directly contradict frictionless 'export and leave': one user was forced to sign up for Postman's cloud service just to migrate data to a new laptop (postman-comm-15), and another reported that Postman's cloud sync silently lost their environment data (secrets/keys) during a support-assisted restore (postman-comm-4), undermining trust in exporting/owning your own data outside Postman's cloud. Missing for 10: an explicit, documented one-click 'export all workspaces/environments/vault data' feature, and any independent confirmation that a full data export actually succeeds without cloud dependency.
